sb.controlla_agg_aiuto: Once a day AnimeUp asks GitHub for the latest release and, if there's a newer one, shows a note at the top of the sidebar with a link to it. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically. It's the only connection AnimeUp makes by itself after the first launch.
sb.cartella_in_aiuto: Where you copy the episodes to upscale. AnimeUp watches it and analyses new files by itself. It can be on an external drive, and it stays chosen until you change it. If it isn't available at launch (a disconnected drive), AnimeUp uses ~/Movies/AnimeUp/INPUT and tells you.
sb.cartella_in_prompt: Choose the folder of videos to process
sb.cartella_out_aiuto: Where upscaled videos are saved, with each file's log in its logs folder. The work files of running and interrupted jobs (JOBS) live here too and can take tens of GB, so choose a disk with room. It stays chosen until you change it. If it isn't available at launch, AnimeUp uses ~/Movies/AnimeUp/OUTPUT and tells you.
sb.cartella_out_prompt: Choose the folder for finished videos
pa.intro: One last step before the first job: AnimeUp needs its video tools, which it keeps in its own folder and doesn't share with anything else on your Mac.
pa.voce_ffmpeg: **FFmpeg 9.0.2**: reads, analyses and encodes the video. It's downloaded rather than included because of its licence (GPLv3).
pa.voce_ncnn: **Real-ESRGAN and Real-CUGAN**: the upscaling engines, with their models.
pa.nota: About {mb} MB, from the projects' official releases, verified by checksum. It's done once: after that AnimeUp works offline.
pa.errore: The download didn't complete. Check the connection and try again; what's already downloaded is kept.
sb.cartella_assente: The folder {scelta} isn't available (is its drive connected?). For now AnimeUp is using {attuale}.
sb.aggiornamento_chiesto: AnimeUp will ask you to confirm, download the update, check it and restart.
